operations.summary: List the ui_page plugin pages this principal may open
operations.summary_zh: 列出当前身份可打开的插件页面（ui_page）
operations.description: Any authenticated session. Only plugins enabled on this installation (and still served by the license service) are listed, filtered by the page role (platform scope = admin), its required_permission (no platform.admin fallback) and its required_module (lease). The web app mounts each page in <iframe sandbox="allow-scripts allow-forms"> on the plugin origin.

responses.description_zh: 认证失败或会话已失效。

operations.summary: The installation public key plugin backends verify proxied calls with
operations.summary_zh: 插件后端用来校验代理调用的本安装公钥
operations.description: Requires plugin_installations.read or plugin_installations.manage (any scope) or platform.admin in the platform scope. Public material only: the administrator hands public_key to a ui_page plugin backend so it can verify X-Cdnca-Plugin-Signature; key_id equals X-Cdnca-Plugin-Key-Id. 503 plugin_ui_proxy_unavailable when this installation has no key configured.

fields.name: public_key
fields.description: base64url (no padding) raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key

operations.summary: One-click plugin identity status of this tenant
operations.summary_zh: 本租户的插件一键授权状态
operations.description: Tenant session that may open a user page of this enabled ui_page plugin with an api_base_url. Lists the permissions the identity would carry (the installation's approved scopes that an API key may hold, minus platform.*), which of them the caller holds, and the current identity (who authorized it, when). Never returns key material.

operations.summary: Authorize the plugin; the control plane issues its identity and hands it to the plugin backend
operations.summary_zh: 授权插件：主控签发插件身份并交给插件后端
operations.description: Requires api_keys.self.manage (same rule as POST /v1/account/api-keys; refused while impersonating). The control plane issues an API key bound to this tenant's installation with the scopes of GET .../identity granted_scopes, and delivers it only to the plugin backend: PUT {api_base_url}/plugin-identity signed like the proxy (X-Cdnca-Plugin-*; context delivery "plugin_identity") with body {api_key, api_key_id, scopes, issued_by_user_id, issued_by_display_name, issued_at}. Once delivered, older identities of the installation in this tenant are revoked at once; a failed delivery revokes the new key (502 plugin_identity_delivery_failed). An identity another member authorized can be replaced only with plugin_installations.manage. Audited as plugin.identity.grant and api_key.plugin_identity.revoke.

responses.description: The plugin identity status (never the secret).

fields.name: granted_scopes
fields.description: required_scopes the caller holds (what an authorization grants)

operations.summary: Revoke the plugin's authorization in this tenant
operations.summary_zh: 撤销插件在本租户的授权
operations.description: Requires api_keys.self.manage; revoking an identity another member authorized needs plugin_installations.manage. Revocation is immediate (the next plugin call is 401); the plugin backend is then told with a signed DELETE {api_base_url}/plugin-identity (best effort). Audited as plugin.identity.revoke.

responses.description: The plugin identity status (never the secret).

operations.summary: Call a ui_page plugin's own backend on behalf of one of its pages
operations.summary_zh: 代插件页面调用该插件自己的后端
operations.description:
Any authenticated session that may open page_id. The control plane forwards method/path/query/body to the plugin's declared api_base_url (public addresses only, no redirects, JSON only) without the user's session or token; it adds X-Cdnca-Plugin-Context (base64url JSON, schema cdnca.plugin-ui-context/v1, 60 s), X-Cdnca-Plugin-Signature (Ed25519 by the installation key over "cdnca-plugin-ui-proxy/v1
" + METHOD + "
" + path?query + "
" + hex(sha256(body)) + "
" + context) and X-Cdnca-Plugin-Key-Id. site_id must be a site the caller can access. Writes and refusals are audited as plugin.ui_page.proxy. 120 calls per minute per user and plugin.

responses.description: The plugin backend answer (status and JSON body only).
